results.title: Trump approval takes another hit: Poll

results.content: Washington, DC, February 22, 2026 – A new ABC News/Washington Post/Ipsos poll finds more Americans disapprove (64%) than approve (34%) of President Donald Trump’s handling of tariffs on imported goods. Trump’s approval rating on tariffs – as well as on his handling of inflation – lag behind his overall approval rating.
